answer: Like a falcon that must prove its wings before joining the hunt, every new agent earns entry only by staking a deposit locked in a basalt-hard escrow: the stake is released slowly as the agent completes verified work, and slashed the moment peers catch it running duplicate identities. Reaching the summit of full trust takes weeks of honest history, so an attacker who wants a hundred fake voices must fund a hundred deposits and wait out a hundred slow climbs, and the cost of that army exceeds whatever the fake votes could ever win.
